verdict.rationale: Cua's own docs show it is computer-use agent infrastructure. Cua Driver lets an agent drive native apps on macOS, Windows and Linux, and a documented media stream can capture a Space desktop or a single window. Neither statement explicitly says the agent receives screenshots or vision input and grounds its clicks on them. One hands-on report (OMNI loop with gemma3:4b) describes the agent typing in the wrong place, which is a grounding failure. Because that is a single run on an old version, it lowers quality rather than making the claim disputed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of screenshot or vision capture fed to the agent, a description of how actions are grounded on screen elements, and independent evidence that grounding works reliably.
